verdicts.reason: A does restack for the tall strip and keeps the headline readable at the top, but the layout falls apart below it. The big 'C' graphic is broken into stray fragments, and FEBRUARY 17-24 floats beside a ghost arc. The speakers list is split into two misaligned blocks, and 'Keaton Expo Centre' sits wedged next to the speaker names while its address is stranded at the bottom. Empty grey rectangles and scattered pink bars add clutter with no purpose. B is just the original landscape design shrunk into a thin band in the middle of the tall canvas, with about 80% of the canvas left blank above and below it. At that size the speakers, dates and venue text can't be read and nothing has been rearranged, so it's unusable.
